note: G47: noisy-OR against max, one variable, reported on G46's partition so a gain cannot hide inside the leaky third.

controls.name: C1_copy_reproduces_the_original_under_max
controls.must_fire_because: the rewritten file under the ORIGINAL setting must return the ORIGINAL published figure, or it is a different instrument and no arm from it means anything
controls.can_fail_because: the max arm returning anything but 0.2648 / 0.3929
controls.null_must_contain: a differing figure: the literals are transcribed from G34/RESULT.md

observations.what_would_fail_it: the max arm of the rewritten file returning anything but 0.2648 / 0.3929

controls.name: C2_operators_differ
controls.must_fire_because: the two aggregation operators must actually differ, or the rewrite is inert by construction and F3 could not detect it
controls.can_fail_because: both operators returning the same score for the same confidences
controls.null_must_contain: an equal pair, which is what an inert rewrite would produce

observations.what_would_fail_it: both operators returning the same score for the same two confidences, which would make the rewrite inert by construction

controls.name: C3_partition_recombines
controls.must_fire_because: the parts must sum to the test set, as in G46
controls.can_fail_because: parts that do not sum, or an empty part
controls.null_must_contain: an unequal sum, which a mis-scoped mask would produce

observations.what_would_fail_it: the parts not summing to the test set

falsifiers.name: F1_noisy_or_does_not_help_the_clean_partition
falsifiers.can_fail_because: the no-same-pair gain is at or below the 0.002 floor stated first
falsifiers.null_must_contain: no gain, which the same harness reports for the max arm against itself

observations.threshold_is: an absolute floor chosen before the run, NOT a measured seed band -- no seed band for filtered MRR exists in this lane and inventing one would be A26

falsifiers.refutes: the hypothesis G30 named: that the aggregation operator explains part of the gap to published rule miners
falsifiers.fires_when: the no-same-pair gain is at or below the 0.002 floor stated first
falsifiers.verdict: survived — the falsifier did not fire

falsifiers.name: F2_gain_is_bought_on_the_leaky_third
falsifiers.can_fail_because: the blended arm gains while the leakage-free partition does not
falsifiers.null_must_contain: a clean-partition gain, which is what would license the claim
falsifiers.refutes: the right to report any gain as a METHOD improvement
falsifiers.fires_when: the blended arm gains while the leakage-free partition does not
falsifiers.verdict: survived — the falsifier did not fire

falsifiers.name: F3_rewrite_is_inert
falsifiers.can_fail_because: the noisy-OR arm returning exactly the max arm's blended MRR
falsifiers.null_must_contain: a moved number, which C2 shows the operators can produce
falsifiers.refutes: that this run measures anything about aggregation at all
falsifiers.fires_when: the noisy-OR arm returning exactly the max arm's blended MRR
falsifiers.verdict: survived — the falsifier did not fire

falsifier: no gain on the leakage-free partition, which would say the aggregation difference G30 named does not explain the gap for this rule set
